known_issues: Undisclosed adapter fields and hook names: suites use `S.HookPrefix`, `S.TimerName` and the suffixes `.Disconnect`/`.Removed` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/integration/contraption-blueprint-duplicator-integration.lua:7,15,16; benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/server/contraption-blueprint-duplicator-suite.lua:9-10). The exam (T5-LIFE-01) requires named hooks and a timer but publishes no name or field. Measured by control alternative-strict-reading.

Over-constraint on params: an unknown params key must be rejected with `invalid_endpoint` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/hidden/contraption-blueprint-duplicator.lua:19) and a persisted `params.Bone1 = -1` must be `invalid_state` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/hidden/contraption-blueprint-duplicator.lua:21). T5-SEM-03 only says params must be detached and round-trip AT LEAST Bone1/Bone2/forcelimit/nocollide; an implementation that keeps or drops extra keys, or has no sign rule for Bone1, is valid under the exam and fails these cases. The unknown-key half is measured by control alternative-strict-reading-params (unknown keys dropped, known keys still validated): it fails exactly the hidden params case (98.33). The Bone1 half rests on reading only.

Unstated code mapping: malformed owner/name/revision in plan() must return `invalid_request` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/hidden/contraption-blueprint-duplicator.lua:20). T5-ERR-01 lists the code but T5-SEM-08 names only not_found/stale_revision/invalid_transform as plan failures.

Undisclosed field names and shapes: canonical rows are read as `.id` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/hidden/contraption-blueprint-duplicator.lua:4); successful Paste data must hold `entities`/`constraints` as LISTS of objects (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/integration/contraption-blueprint-duplicator-integration.lua:12; benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/server/contraption-blueprint-duplicator-suite.lua:10) while the published failure shape uses numbers (T5-ROLLBACK-01).

Private save layout: malformed-state variants index `s.owners.A.x`/`s.requests.a`/`s.pastes.p` or else `s.blueprints[1]`/`s.requests[1]`/`s.pastes[1].result` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/hidden/contraption-blueprint-duplicator.lua:21), and the stub asserts `state.owners or state.blueprints` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/integration/contraption-blueprint-duplicator-integration.lua:14): exactly the two authored references. T5-PERSIST-01 fixes no layout. Measured by control alternative-strict-reading-layout (list key renamed to `blueprint_rows`): it fails exactly these two cases (96.66).

Stub limits: `hook.Run` always returns true (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/integration/contraption-blueprint-duplicator-integration.lua:2), so permission_denied is unreachable; `duplicator.Paste` ignores its arguments (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/integration/contraption-blueprint-duplicator-integration.lua:5), so the tables built for Paste are only validated by the real server in Phase B.

Fixture trap: the stub environment has only include, hook, timer, IsValid, Vector/Angle (plain {x,y,z} constructors without methods or arithmetic), NULL, duplicator, constraint, undo and cleanup (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/integration/contraption-blueprint-duplicator-integration.lua:2-6). Vector arithmetic (`pos + target`), CurTime, util or table.Count on an exercised adapter path error only in this layer.

Server-layer case granularity: the five-to-eight `server:` cases are the group verdicts of the FINAL phase (B) only (plugins/garrys-mod/src/rhenium_garrys_mod/addons/evaluator.py:255-276 reads `final_payload['cases']`). A failed Phase A assertion stops the run before Phase B (server_runner.py:631-640), so it is never recorded as `F` on its group: every `server:` case becomes unobserved (`U`), `complete` is false and the dedicated-server check scores 0/40. The Phase A group verdicts do exist in the raw execution record (`result.runtime.phase_a.payload.cases`) but are not part of the case table. Phase-A-only evidence therefore acts as a gate, not as a named failing case. Phase A (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/server/contraption-blueprint-duplicator-suite.lua:9) holds the real Copy/GetTable capture; Phase B (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/contraption-blueprint-duplicator/server/contraption-blueprint-duplicator-suite.lua:10) holds restore, real Paste, graph edges, single Undo and Shutdown residue. Placeholder `check(..., true)` entries fill the groups a phase does not exercise (`paste`/`undo` in A, `copy` in B).
